title: Native launcher should configure an empty checkout before scoped build
body: A fresh native checkout has no CMake build tree. Running the documented scoped invocation tools/vixen-native.sh ... build build vixen-ninja target reaches build.bat build and fails before compilation with cmake.exe Error: C:/vixen-native/hudkit1/build/ninja is not a directory (queue log /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1794597979-build-cx-hudkit1:target-build.log). Recovery is build.bat all vixen-ninja target (configure plus build). The launcher should either auto-configure an absent build directory or fail earlier with the exact required all or configure action. Tier haiku: one launcher precondition or diagnostic; effort S.

title: Native CTest launcher should safely pass regex arguments
body: The documented native CTest wrapper fails before CTest when a queued invocation passes a normal regex containing alternation through VIXEN_NATIVE_ARGS: tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat receives -R HudSmokeTest|HudViewTest and cmd.exe exits 255 with an unexpected-at-this-time parse error. Recovery is to run one single-pattern queued invocation at a time. The wrapper should preserve arbitrary CTest regex arguments as one quoted argument, or expose a safe structured selector. Tier haiku: one batch argument boundary; effort S.

title: Box queue flow should provide its pinned reservation publisher
body: A queued native GPU capture admitted after the live wrapper printed /home/liory/Github/box-queue/compat/../queue/with-test-lock.sh: line 13663: _flow_publish_pinned_reservation: command not found. The same wrapper then admitted the job, so reservation publishing is a missing internal helper rather than a product failure. The queue should ship the helper or degrade with an explicit supported fallback before admission. Tier haiku: one queue-core helper or fallback; effort S.
